verdicts.rationale: REST v2 /entities/upsert endpoint performs automatic type coercion using github.com/spf13/cast library instead of strict schema validation. This allows incorrect types to be accepted (string→int/double/bool, int→bool) when gRPC path properly rejects them with DataNotMatchException. Source code analysis (utils.go lines 615-775) confirms cast.ToBoolE/ToInt16E/ToFloat64E calls with coercion logic. Cross-channel inconsistency is documented as a defect pattern in developer_cognition.json. Step 1 reproduction showed 4 successful upserts with type mismatches that should fail. This is a genuine Type1_IllegalSuccess defect.
